summary.text: Malik Williams is the Democratic candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 83 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he works as a family law legal aid attorney and community organizer.

paragraphs.text: Malik Williams earned a bachelor's degree from Texas Tech University in 2020 and a law degree from Texas Tech School of Law in 2024.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Williams said he was raised by a single mother, was the first in his family to graduate from high school, college and law school, and has worked in Washington, D.C., and Ireland.
He described himself as a former fellow to Congresswoman Sheila Jackson Lee.
Williams advanced from the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026.
In the survey, he listed affordable housing, higher wages, child care, public education and health care as his key priorities.
